svg.title: Threat detection and automated response on AWS
svg.desc: Threat detection and automated response on AWS. 11 components in 4 groups. Connections: Amazon GuardDuty to AWS Security Hub; Amazon Inspector to AWS Security Hub; AWS Config to AWS Security Hub; Amazon Macie to AWS Security Hub (findings); AWS Security Hub to Amazon EventBridge (imported findings); Amazon EventBridge to AWS Lambda (invoke); Amazon EventBridge to Amazon Simple Notification Service (publish); Amazon EventBridge to AWS Systems Manager (start); AWS Security Hub to Amazon Security Lake (archive); Amazon Security Lake to Security Lake bucket.

text.tspan: THREAT DETECTION AND AUTOMATED RESPONSE ON AWS
Four detectors send findings to Security Hub, EventBridge rules start the response, and Security Lake keeps every finding
